name: Mr. Peanut
creator: Antonio Gentile / Planters
feat: Eyes, mouth, arms, legs, top hat, monocle, cane
sum: A peanut dressed as a gentleman in top hat, monocle and cane; for over a century the face of the Planters brand.

name: Bertie Bassett
creator: Greenly’s agency / Bassett’s
feat: Liquorice pieces assembled as head, torso and limbs
sum: A man assembled entirely from Bassett's liquorice allsorts, used as the confectionery brand's mascot.

name: Miss Chiquita (banana form)
creator: Dik Browne / Chiquita
feat: Banana-shaped figure; face, arms, legs, costume
sum: A banana in costume who acts as the spokeswoman for Chiquita bananas; the fruit itself is her body.

name: Red M&M
creator: Mars / BBDO; later Will Vinton Studios
feat: Candy-shaped body, face, arms, white gloves, legs
sum: A plain chocolate candy with arms, legs and white gloves, shown as the confident, wisecracking face of M&M's.

name: Yellow M&M
creator: Mars / BBDO; later Will Vinton Studios
feat: Oval candy body, face, arms, white gloves, legs
sum: A peanut candy character, the cheerful and naive counterpart to Red.

name: Pillsbury Doughboy (Poppin’ Fresh)
creator: Rudy Perz and Milt Schaffer / Pillsbury
feat: Dough-shaped human figure, eyes, mouth, arms, legs, chef hat, scarf
sum: A friendly figure made of dough, in chef's hat and scarf, who stands for Pillsbury's refrigerated dough products.

name: Mayor McCheese
creator: McDonald’s / McDonaldland creative team
feat: Cheeseburger head, human torso, arms, legs, mayoral sash
sum: A cheeseburger-headed official in a mayoral sash who governs McDonaldland, the fantasy world of McDonald's advertising.

name: Officer Big Mac
creator: McDonald’s / McDonaldland creative team
feat: Big Mac head, police uniform, arms, legs, whistle
sum: A police officer with a Big Mac for a head who keeps order in McDonaldland, McDonald's advertising world.

name: Twinkie the Kid
creator: Denny Lesser / Hostess
feat: Twinkie-shaped body, eyes, limbs, cowboy hat, gloves, boots
sum: A Twinkie dressed as a Western cowboy, with hat, gloves and boots, used as Hostess's mascot.

name: Anpanman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Froebel-kan
feat: Round bread head, facial features, human body, cape
sum: A hero whose head is a red-bean bun; he gives a piece of his face to feed people who are hungry.

name: Currypanman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Curry-bread head, facial features, human body
sum: A curry-bread-headed character in the Anpanman cast, a friend and rival of the hero.

name: Shokupanman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Slice-of-bread head, face, formal outfit
sum: A white-bread-headed character in formal clothes, a friend of Anpanman who delivers school bread.

name: Omusubiman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Triangular rice-ball head, facial features, humanoid outfit
sum: A traveling character with an onigiri (rice ball) head in the Anpanman cast.

name: Tendonman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Rice-bowl head with food, face, limbs
sum: A character whose head is a tempura rice bowl, a bowl of food worn as a face in the Anpanman cast.

name: Hamburger Kid
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Hamburger head, facial features, Western-style clothing
sum: A hamburger-headed character in Western-style clothes in the Anpanman cast.

name: Katsudonman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Food-filled bowl head, facial features, limbs
sum: A character whose head is a bowl of rice topped with pork cutlet (katsudon).

name: Kamameshidon
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Pot-shaped food head, facial features, limbs
sum: A character with a pot-shaped head, drawn from kamameshi, rice cooked and served in a small pot.

name: Melonpanna
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Round melon-bread head, facial features, humanoid body
sum: A girl character with a melon-bread (melonpan) head in the Anpanman cast.

name: Bob the Tomato
creator: Phil Vischer / Big Idea Productions
feat: Tomato body with eyes and mouth; no regular arms or legs
sum: A tomato with only eyes and a mouth, no arms or legs, who hosts VeggieTales from a kitchen countertop.

name: Larry the Cucumber
creator: Mike Nawrocki and Phil Vischer / Big Idea
feat: Cucumber body with facial features; no regular arms or legs
sum: A cucumber with no arms or legs, Bob's co-host and the singer of the series' silly songs.

name: Junior Asparagus
creator: Big Idea Productions / VeggieTales
feat: Asparagus-shaped body, eyes, mouth
sum: A young asparagus, the child of the VeggieTales cast, whose fears and mistakes drive many of the stories.

name: Rollpanna
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Bread-inspired head, humanoid body and ribbons
sum: A girl in the Anpanman cast with ribbons and a bread-roll-inspired head.

name: Frankencelery
creator: Big Idea Productions / VeggieTales
medium: Direct-to-video animation: Where’s God When I’m S-Scared?
feat: Celery-like monster with facial features
sum: A celery monster in the style of a horror film, a movie character within the VeggieTales story.

name: Laura Carrot
creator: Big Idea Productions / VeggieTales
feat: Carrot-shaped body, eyes, mouth, green foliage
sum: A carrot with green foliage for hair, one of the female leads of the VeggieTales cast.

name: Blue M&M
creator: Mars / BBDO
feat: Blue candy body, face, arms, gloves, legs
sum: A blue candy with white gloves and a laid-back, cool personality.

name: Green M&M
creator: Mars / BBDO
feat: Green candy body, arms, gloves, legs, changing shoes
sum: A confident green candy known for her footwear, which became a visible part of her image.

name: Madame Blueberry
creator: Big Idea Productions / VeggieTales
feat: Blueberry body, facial features, clothing in some scenes
sum: A blueberry with a face and, in some scenes, clothing; she is the lead of a moral tale in the VeggieTales style.

name: Cream Panda
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Cream-bread head, facial features, humanoid body
sum: A boy with a head of cream-filled bread, known for his energy.

name: Yakisobapanman
creator: Takashi Yanase / Anpanman
feat: Bread head with noodle filling, human-like body
sum: A character with a bun for a head and yakisoba noodles as the filling, one of the many bread heroes of Anpanman's world.

name: Orange M&M
creator: Mars / M&M’s
feat: Orange candy body, facial features, arms, gloves, legs
sum: A nervous, anxious orange candy with white gloves, whose worrying is his main trait.

name: Kogepan
creator: Miki Takahashi / San-X
feat: Burnt bun body, eyes, mouth, small limbs
sum: A bun baked too long and left burnt, turned from a rejected product into a lovable character.

name: Kireipan
creator: Miki Takahashi / San-X
feat: Bread bun body with face and small limbs
sum: A perfectly baked bun with bright energy, the opposite of the burnt Kogepan.

name: Bad Apple
creator: Kellogg’s / Apple Jacks
feat: Red apple body, eyes, mouth, arms, legs
sum: A red apple with arms and legs, drawn as the troublemaker in cereal commercials opposite CinnaMon.

name: CinnaMon
creator: Kellogg’s / Apple Jacks
feat: Brown cinnamon-stick body, face, arms, legs
sum: A brown cinnamon stick with arms and legs, the friendly one of the pair in the cereal commercials.

name: Petunia Rhubarb
creator: Big Idea Productions / VeggieTales
feat: Green vegetable body, facial features, red hair in some designs
sum: A green rhubarb character, sometimes drawn with red hair, in the VeggieTales world.

name: GingerBrave
creator: Devsisters
feat: Gingerbread body, face, arms, legs
sum: A gingerbread cookie hero with a simple face and limbs who became the face of Cookie Run.

name: Annoying Orange
creator: Dane Boedigheimer
feat: Real orange with composited human eyes and mouth
sum: A real orange with digitally added eyes and a mouth, whose jokes annoy the fruit and vegetables around him.

name: GingerDozer
creator: Devsisters
feat: Gingerbread body, face, small limbs
sum: A gingerbread cookie character in the Cookie Run (OvenBreak) world.

name: Tonkatsu
creator: San-X / Sumikkogurashi
feat: Pink cutlet-like body, eyes, mouth
sum: A pink, cutlet-like character who prefers the corners, one of the Sumikkogurashi ("living in the corner") cast.

name: Ebifurai no Shippo
creator: San-X / Sumikkogurashi
feat: Fried shrimp tail body, eyes and mouth
sum: A fried shrimp tail, the part people leave on the plate, who is friends with Tonkatsu.

name: Tapioca
creator: San-X / Sumikkogurashi
feat: Round tapioca pearl, simple face
sum: A tapioca pearl left in the cup after the milk tea is gone.

name: Strawberry Cookie
creator: Devsisters
feat: Cookie body, face, arms, legs, strawberry hood
sum: A cookie character with a strawberry hood from the Cookie Run games.

name: GingerBright
creator: Devsisters
feat: Gingerbread body, eyes, mouth, arms, legs
sum: A gingerbread character in the Cookie Run games, one of the series' gingerbread cookies.

name: Ms. Brown M&M
creator: Mars / M&M’s
feat: Brown candy body, face, arms, gloves, legs
sum: A brown chocolate candy portrayed as a poised, businesslike woman.

name: Gudetama
creator: Sanrio
feat: Egg yolk body, eyes, mouth, small limbs
sum: An egg yolk that would rather lie around than do anything; the name blends 'gudaguda' (lazy) with 'tamago' (egg).

name: KIRIMI-chan.
creator: Sanrio
feat: Salmon-slice body, facial features, limbs
sum: A slice of salmon fillet turned into a character; in Japanese, 'kirimi' means a cut slice of fish.

name: Frank (Sausage Party)
creator: Seth Rogen, Evan Goldberg and filmmakers / Sony
feat: Sausage body, face, arms, legs
sum: A sausage in an adult-rated animated comedy, where supermarket food is given human voices and desires.

name: Brenda Bun (Sausage Party)
creator: Seth Rogen, Evan Goldberg and filmmakers / Sony
feat: Bun body, eyes, mouth, arms, legs
sum: A hot-dog bun, Frank's companion among the supermarket products.

name: Purple M&M
creator: Mars / M&M’s
feat: Purple peanut-shaped candy, eyes, limbs, white gloves
sum: A peanut-shaped purple candy with white gloves, joining the older M&M's characters.

name: Frosted Strawberry Pop-Tart (Bowl mascot)
creator: Pop-Tarts / Kellanova
feat: Rectangular pastry body, face, arms, legs
sum: A rectangular strawberry-frosted pastry with a face and limbs, used as the mascot of a college football bowl.
